name: GRES benchmark gRefCOCO
description: GRES benchmark gRefCOCO evaluates generalized referring expression segmentation, focusing on identifying multiple objects or empty targets in images, challenging models to handle complex spatial relationships and null references.
reputation: A specialized but increasingly used benchmark in referring expression segmentation, especially for testing multi-object and null-target handling beyond standard RefCOCO-style setups.
notes: Introduces GSVA method and sets new record on gRefCOCO dataset for generalized referring expression segmentation.
